{{Quote|This planet does look promising, though. It has lots of shelter for concealment, lots of plant life for provisions, and lots of&mdash;"<br />"Gundarks!|Leia Organa and C-3PO, upon landing on Kharzet III|<ref name="marvel51" />}}
'''Kharzet III''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that was uncharted as of [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="marvel51" /> The planet's lush forests were home a wide variety of plant life, and also to a unique [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Gundark/Legends|gundark]] known as the [[long-necked gundark]].<ref name="EGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] scouted the planet for possible new location for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] base after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], but they they quickly fled after coming under attacked by long-necked gundarks.<ref name="marvel51" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kharzet III first appeared in [[Star Wars (1977) 51|''Star Wars 51: Resurrection of Evil'']], written by [[Archie Goodwin]] and released in [[1981]]. Although the planet went unidentified in its initial appearance,<ref name="marvel51" /> it later received a name in the 2001 reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|The Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'', which mentioned the unique gundark species shown in the comic.<ref name="EGAS" />
